## Feature Description / Requirements

**July Release on 19July:**

We have executed Assessment Configuration in latest run of July release and observed some of the APIs are taking time to respond.

AssessmentsConfiguration → Search - Max 105sec  
AssessmentsConfiguration → Select Configuration - Max 57sec  
AssessmentsConfiguration → EvaluationFilter - Max 48 sec  
AssessmentsConfiguration → SelectRule - Max 54 sec
